page:
OpenAPI Plugin configuration reference for auto-generating API documentation. Installation: `bun add @elysia/openapi`. Basic usage: .use(openapi()), .get(), .post(), then access /openapi (Scalar UI) or /openapi/json (raw spec). Plugin extends OpenAPI Operation Object. Detail field describes route information.
Questions: How do you install OpenAPI plugin? How do you generate docs? What formats are available?

sections.manifest:
Detail field structure following OpenAPI Operation Object. Used to describe route information. Properties: hide (hide from Swagger), deprecated (declare deprecated operation), description (verbose operation behavior), summary (short operation summary). Auto-completion and type-safety provided.
Questions: What is detail field? What properties are available?

detail.hide to hide route from Swagger page. Set detail.hide: true to hide. Example: { detail: { hide: true } }. Route not displayed in documentation.
Questions: How do you hide routes?

detail.deprecated, detail.description, detail.summary properties. Deprecated: declares operation deprecated. Description: verbose operation explanation. Summary: short operation summary.
Questions: What properties describe operations?

Config options accepted by plugin.
Questions: What config options exist?

enabled property - default true. Enable/disable plugin.
Questions: How do you disable plugin?

documentation property - OpenAPI info. Refers to OpenAPI v3.0.3 spec.
Questions: What info can you provide?

exclude property - exclude paths/methods from documentation.
Questions: What can you exclude?

exclude.methods - list of HTTP methods to exclude.
Questions: How do you exclude methods?

exclude.paths - list of paths to exclude.
Questions: How do you exclude paths?

exclude.staticFile - default true. Exclude static file routes from documentation.
Questions: How do you exclude static files?

exclude.tags - list of tags to exclude from documentation.
Questions: How do you exclude tags?

mapJsonSchema - custom mapping function from standard schema to OpenAPI schema. Example: toJsonSchema from @valibot/to-json-schema for Valibot mapping.
Questions: How do you map custom schemas? What schemas are supported?

path property - default '/openapi'. Endpoint to expose OpenAPI documentation frontend.
Questions: What is default documentation path? How customize?

provider property - default 'scalar'. OpenAPI frontend providers: Scalar, SwaggerUI, null (disable frontend).
Questions: What UI providers exist? How choose provider?

references - additional OpenAPI reference for each endpoint.
Questions: What are references?

scalar property - Scalar configuration. Refers to Scalar GitHub config. Self-hosted bundle option: cdn property overrides URI to bundle (cdn is Elysia override, not Scalar's). withDefaultFonts false disables Scalar's font CDN.
Questions: How do you configure Scalar? How self-host?

specPath property - default '/${path}/json'. Endpoint to expose OpenAPI spec in JSON format.
Questions: What is raw spec path? How customize?

swagger property - Swagger configuration. Refers to Swagger config documentation. Common patterns available for plugin usage.
Questions: How do you configure Swagger? What patterns exist?
